title: Fill gaps in AWDL DataPathStateTLV.
description: This PR fills in a few extra fields on the DataPathStateTLV for the AWDL protocol. It also contains a fix for preview channel numbers on channel sequences.

Looks strange to me to show the second byte first and opening the first byte undr it ina new subtree.
Reverse the order and skip the subtree? (same for line 782)

So basically, depending on the encoding, either the first or second byte is the channel number, the other byte are flags or opclass. This just previews the channel number, I wasn't involved in creating the original code, but the way it is now, it's broken and parses both bytes as the channel number.
